structured.target: SXD AI CIIC 2025 circular fashion zero waste founders school
structured.school_or_org: SXD AI / Shelly Xu Design (SXD, Inc.); founder Shelly Xu, Harvard Business School MBA 2021
structured.what_it_does: SXD AI uses patent-published AI, trained on proprietary design data, to generate scalable zero-waste garment patterns that eliminate fabric waste at the design stage. It co-designs and scales zero-material-waste products for brands and manufacturers, aiming for large material savings, CO2 cuts, and lower production cost. Partners are required to reinvest savings into fair wages.
structured.place: Headquartered New York, NY (United States); CIIC pilot/partnership focus Indonesia (e.g. Busana Apparel Group); also listed as working in Bangladesh and other markets
structured.outcome_or_award: Winner of CIIC 2025 Circular Economy track; one of three winners sharing a total Rp10 billion catalytic grant to pilot solutions in Indonesia (Grand Finale 11 Oct 2025 at Indonesia International Sustainability Forum, Jakarta)
structured.gap: Exact split of the Rp10 billion among the three CIIC winners not published; full SXD AI co-founder/team roster beyond Shelly Xu not listed on CIIC/Temasek/East Ventures pages; MIT Solve leaves country HQ field blank though city is New York, NY; undergraduate school of Shelly Xu not verified in fetched sources.
structured.note: SEA climate-tech (CIIC), not PH Youth CLAP. CIIC 2025 is the 3rd edition, organized by East Ventures and Temasek Foundation; ~500 applicants, 9 finalists, three track winners (Energy Transition / Sustainable Agriculture / Circular Economy). Claimed impact metrics from official materials: ~10x material savings, ~80% CO2 reduction, up to ~55% cost savings vs other approaches. Founder also HBS NVC Social Enterprise Track Grand Prize & Crowd Favorite (2021); MIT Solve 2024 Global Climate Challenge solver. Useful for student teams: zero-waste by design + AI scaling + Indonesia manufacturing pilot path under CIIC.
